section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Instruments and Sender Gauges
title: INSPECT LEVEL WARNING SWITCH OPERATION / WATER TEMPERATURE GAUGE

content.description: Level warning switch circuit diagram showing battery voltage applied between terminals 1 and 3 through a 3.4W bulb

items: (a) Apply battery voltage between terminals 1 and 3 through a 3.4W bulb. Check that the bulb lights.

content.description: Level warning switch submerged in container with gasoline or water, showing test bulb and battery connection

items: (b) Submerge the switch in gasoline or water. Check that the bulb goes out.
If operation is not as specified, replace the sender gauge.

content.description: Water temperature gauge receiver circuit diagram showing ignition switch, gauge, test bulb 3.4W, and battery connections

items: (a) Disconnect the connector from the sender gauge. Ground the terminal through a 3.4W bulb as shown.
(b) Turn the ignition switch on. Check that the bulb lights up and that the receiver gauge needle rises to the upper position.
If indications are not as specified, remove and test the receiver gauge.

content.text: Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between terminals.
If each resistance value is not as shown in the table below, replace the receiver gauge.

content.description: Receiver gauge terminal layout diagram showing positions of terminals IG, E, and U

content.text: Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between the terminal and ground.
If each resistance value is not as shown in the table below, replace the sender gauge.
